detector_technology_selection.statement: we consider Si-APD's for 810 and SNSPD's for 1550
detector_technology_selection.manufacturer_preference: SNSPD from Single Quantum datasheets; Si-APDs from Thorlabs datasheets
detector_technology_selection.scope: Technology and manufacturer preference only. Representative model/preset choices are simulator assumptions, not mission hardware selection or unit calibration. Identical receivers at both OGSs are assumed.

source_rate_interpretation.scope: Confirms the interpretation of the workbook rate, not source calibration, CW/pulsed operation, emission statistics or in-band brightness.
